# cycle_stack (Resource)

Manages a Cycle stack (`/v1/stacks`). Stacks describe an environment as code and are sourced from a git repository or an inline stack spec. Exactly one of `source.git_repo` or `source.raw` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An inline stack spec. The spec is stored on create; building it is a
# separate cycle_stack_build resource.
resource "cycle_stack" "demo" {
  name       = "Demo"
  identifier = "demo"

  variables = {
    image_tag = "alpine"
  }

  source = {
    raw = jsonencode({
      version = "1.0"
      about = {
        description = "Minimal demo stack"
      }
      containers = {
        web = {
          name = "web"
          image = {
            name = "nginx"
            origin = {
              type = "docker-hub"
              details = {
                target = "nginx:alpine"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    })
  }
}

# Source a stack from a public git repository.
resource "cycle_stack" "from_repo" {
  name = "From Repo"

  source = {
    git_repo = {
      url        = "https://github.com/example/cycle-stack.git"
      branch     = "master"
      stack_file = "cycle.json"
    }
  }
}

# A private repo using HTTP user/token credentials (token is sensitive).
resource "cycle_stack" "private_repo" {
  name = "Private Repo"

  source = {
    git_repo = {
      url    = "https://github.com/example/private-stack.git"
      branch = "main"

      auth = {
        http = {
          username = var.git_username
          token    = var.git_token
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the stack.
- `source` (Attributes) The stack source. Exactly one of `git_repo` or `raw` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))

### Optional

- `identifier` (String) A human-readable slugged identifier for the stack. Automatically generated from the name if not provided. The update API does not accept identifier, so changing this forces a new stack to be created.
- `variables` (Map of String) Default variable values used when building this stack. Anywhere a stack uses `{{var}}`, the matching key from this map is substituted.

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this stack belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the stack.
- `state` (String) The current state of the stack (e.g. `live`).

<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Optional:

- `git_repo` (Attributes) Source the stack from a git repository containing a stack spec file (defaults to `cycle.json` at the repo root). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--git_repo))
- `raw` (String) An inline Cycle stack spec as normalized JSON. Unmarshaled into a `StackSpec` (`version`, `containers`, optional `about`, and so on).

<a id="nestedatt--source--git_repo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.git_repo`

Required:

- `url` (String) The URL of the git repository.

Optional:

- `auth` (Attributes) Authentication for a private repository. Exactly one of `http` (user/token) or `ssh` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--git_repo--auth))
- `branch` (String) The branch to use. Defaults to `master` on the platform when omitted.
- `ref_type` (String) The type of git reference to pin (for example `branch`, `tag`, or `commit`). Must be set together with `ref_value`.
- `ref_value` (String) The value of the git reference identified by `ref_type`. Must be set together with `ref_type`.
- `stack_file` (String) Path to the stack spec file in the repository. Defaults to `cycle.json` at the repo root.

<a id="nestedatt--source--git_repo--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.git_repo.auth`

Optional:

- `http` (Attributes) HTTP user/token credentials. The token is sent to the Cycle API as the HTTP password. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--git_repo--auth--http))
- `ssh` (Attributes) SSH key credentials for the repository. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source--git_repo--auth--ssh))

<a id="nestedatt--source--git_repo--auth--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.git_repo.auth.http`

Required:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token (or password) used for HTTP authentication.
- `username` (String) The username used for HTTP authentication.


<a id="nestedatt--source--git_repo--auth--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source.git_repo.auth.ssh`

Required:

- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) A PEM-encoded private key.
- `username` (String) The username used to authenticate the SSH key.

Optional:

- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive) The passphrase for the private key, if any.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Stacks are imported using their ID.
terraform import cycle_stack.demo 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21
```
